text:
{
  "pros": [
    "Competitive pricing and generous free tier offer great value",
    "Clear navigation and well-grouped features for common tasks",
    "Reliable email delivery and high deliverability rates",
    "Good for basic email marketing and automation needs",
    "Includes SMS and WhatsApp marketing capabilities",
    "Responsive and helpful customer support for common issues"
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Limited advanced features and customization options compared to high-end tools",
    "Reporting and analytics can lack depth for complex insights",
    "Learning curve for more complex automation workflows",
    "Integrations with other platforms can sometimes be limited or clunky",
    "Customer support responsiveness may vary for complex technical issues",
    "Platform performance can be inconsistent, with occasional slowness or unresponsiveness"
  ],
  "changed": [
    "Pro 2 changed due to: [benefit] The sidebar clearly groups CRM (Contacts, Lists, Segments) and Marketing (Campaigns, Statistics, Templates) plus Automations, so the areas the task needs were easy to locate.",
    "Con 6 changed due to: [friction] The Campaigns listing page showed only a spinner for 15+ seconds across three observations and never rendered, so I could not start the welcome, feature-update or promo drafts."
  ]
}

pros: Competitive pricing and generous free tier offer great value
Clear navigation and well-grouped features for common tasks
Reliable email delivery and high deliverability rates

Includes SMS and WhatsApp marketing capabilities
Responsive and helpful customer support for common issues
cons: Limited advanced features and customization options compared to high-end tools
Reporting and analytics can lack depth for complex insights
Learning curve for more complex automation workflows
Integrations with other platforms can sometimes be limited or clunky

Platform performance can be inconsistent, with occasional slowness or unresponsiveness
changed: Pro 2 changed due to: [benefit] The sidebar clearly groups CRM (Contacts, Lists, Segments) and Marketing (Campaigns, Statistics, Templates) plus Automations, so the areas the task needs were easy to locate.

Con 6 changed due to: [friction] The Campaigns listing page showed only a spinner for 15+ seconds across three observations and never rendered, so I could not start the welcome, feature-update or promo drafts.
